headline: Portland Public Schools board to review personnel changes, cell phone policy update, and Portland Adult Education strategic plan.
summary: The board will review personnel items including resignations, terminations, and new hires, hear an update on cell phone policy implementation, and receive a presentation on the Portland Adult Education Strategic Plan. The board will also vote on probationary teacher hires and enter executive session to discuss contract negotiations for several employee groups.
items: Review of personnel items: Resignations, Terminations, Position Shifts, Other Hires
